{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for orders with revenue = 0.00 — could be test or failed orders
zero_revenue = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == 0.00]

# Check if these zero-revenue orders have converted = 0
print(f"Number of completed orders with zero revenue: {len(zero_revenue)}")
print(f"Converted = 0 for zero-revenue orders: {zero_revenue['converted'].sum()} out of {len(zero_revenue)}")

# Check for completed orders with converted = 0
conflict = completed_orders[completed_orders['converted'] == 0]
print(f"Completed orders with converted = 0: {len(conflict)}")

# Print sample of conflicting rows
print("\nSample of conflicting rows (completed but converted = 0):")
print(conflict.head())"}
